caption:
Toddler bed sellers: 16 CFR 1217.2 changed on August 29, 2026.
It now requires each toddler bed to comply with ASTM F1821-26. Before that date, it cited ASTM F1821-19ε1.
If your test reports and certificate file only point to the 2019 version, check them against the current rule.
The free Finder shows which rules apply to a product.
